title.narrative: Support Maternal and Child Health towards a Universal Health Coverage System (PIMI III)

description.narrative: The proposed action intends to ensure increased and better access to quality Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn and Child Health (RMNCH) in Guinea Bissau.The intervention aims at consolidating the process, started in 2013 with the PIMI I[1] programme (2013-2016), implemented in some regions, and subsequently extended to the whole country with PIMI II (2017-2021). title.narrative: Support to the 2023-2025 Electoral cycles in Guinea-Bissau Action

description.narrative: The Action aims at supporting the Government of Guinea-Bissau to hold credible, legitimate and transparent legislative and presidential elections respectively in 2023 and 2025, as foreseen by the country's Constitution, with a view to consolidate democratic governance. It stems from Guinea-Bissau Government request to the technical and financial partners to provide support in the preparation of the elections, via a basket fund managed by the United Nations (UN) or directly to the Government. Promoting democratic participation will help tackle social exclusion, one of the aspect of inequalities. The Action is designed as a follow-up to the EU electoral missions (EU EOM 2014 and EEM 2019).The Action follows the implementation of PACE (Electoral Cycle Support Project) 2018-2019, which was jointly formulated by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). It is based on the conclusions of the UN Electoral Needs Assessment Mission (NAM), of June-July 2022, which stressed the limited capacity of the electoral bodies, the National Elections Commission (CNE) and the Technical Office to Support Electoral Processes (GTAPE). It is also based on the conclusions of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) event on Preventing Electoral Violence in Guinea-Bissau (2022) on the lack of adequate knowledge in the area of citizenship and exercise of civic rights.The intervention, which strengthens the electoral cycle approach adopted by UNDP during the previous elections, will focus on the institutional and technical capacity building of CNE and GTAPE, to strengthen political participation of citizens (including the most vulnerable: women, youth, elders, people living with disability, rural and marginalized populations) and increase transparency of elections results through digitalisation and innovation. The Action will also focus on awareness raising on the rights and responsibilities of citizens in a democratic society and on political participation, as well as on the prevention of elections related conflicts. This will be made through civic education campaigns, the development and implementation of a Political and Media Conduct codes, training and social communication events, with the active involvement of civil society.

title.narrative: Strengthening Democratic Governance in Guinea Bissau

description.narrative: The action aims at strengthening democratic governance in Guinea Bissau, with the purpose of consolidating democracy and facilitating lasting peace in the country. The action will be based on three essential support components: civil society, parliament[1] and elections. The expected results are: (1) strengthened civil society organisations (CSOs) in their role to ensure the vitality of democratic life; (2) trusted and more transparent and accessible democratic institutions at the national level, namely the National Popular Assembly (ANP); (3) smooth electoral cycle processes. The action builds on lessons learned from previous and ongoing EU projects supporting CSOs, the Parliament and electoral processes. The three components of the action, while contributing to the same overall objective, should be implemented with different modalities: indirect management with an entrusted entity or a grant for the CSO component (EUR 3M), a grant to International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (International IDEA) (EUR 1M), and a top up to the UE contribution to the basket fund for elections (1M) or a grant to International IDEA.[1]Guinea-Bissau is one of the few parliamentary democracies in Africa and, as such, the Parliament plays a key role within the governance system and needs to be supported.

description.narrative: The proposed intervention intends to enhance the governance capacities of the ministries of Health, Economy, and Public Administration for an efficient management of the health system, and to facilitate access to quality and inclusive health services and essential medical products. The action is aligned with the national plans on health and builds on lessons learned from previous EU-funded actions. description.narrative: The proposed Action aims at strengthening governance, accountability and efficiency of the education system and improve the employment potential of youth through increased access to Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET).The EU wants to consolidate previous support provided to the Ministry of Education (MEN), namely the production and use of education statistics/information management systems supporting the elaboration of the sectoral policy, the technical and budgetary planning, and the management of human resources. Currently, more than 80% of women are illiterate in rural areas and only 25% of girls complete the basic education.

title.narrative: EU for green and inclusive cities

description.narrative: This Action will follow an integrated approach, supporting policy and institutional reforms, with the participation of civil society. It will aim at improving the urban planning and management, as well as infrastructural interventions in the area of the waste system (treatment and separation centres) in Bissau and the water sector (pumping and water distribution systems) in secondary cities. These components will be associated to strong capacity building at different government levels (national, regional, municipal). This will allow for comprehensive interventions to strengthen urban governance in the long term and to implement concrete and sustainable urban projects. The infrastructure component, in particular the waste management, will also contribute to promote a circular economy (plastic waste recycling channels) and create green jobs. By strengthening governance and inter-institutional coordination and in line with the ambitions of the Global Gateway,  the urban sector in Guinea-Bissau will improve its capacity to adopt an integrated and sustainable urban planning approach and to optimise local taxation. By ensuring access to services, notably waste management in Bissau and urban water and sanitation in other targeted cities, the Action will improve the living conditions of its inhabitants. This Action is expected to trigger additional funding by private sector in complementary areas. This Action is part of the TEI ¿Green cities¿ involving also the EIB who is preparing to resume the collaboration with the country, in particular on waste management and road rehabilitation along the Praia-Dakar-Abidjan Strategic Corridor. In line with the ambitions of the Global Gateway, the construction of this crucial road axis will create the much needed connectivity of the country and set the basis for economic development and regional integration. It will attract new investments, which, paired with this Action, will have a transformative impact on the capital and cities of Guinea-Bissau and its population.The Action will also raise awareness among local authorities on the themes of resilience in the face of climate change, gender equality, health, environmental protection, and sustainable construction techniques.

In this context, worsened by the COVID crisis, the EU re-affirmed its commitment to support human rights and democracy worldwide by adopting the `Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024¿. The actions financed at country level will be in line with: (i) the EU action plan for human rights and democracy; (ii) EU guidelines on human rights; and (iii) the respective Human Rights and Democracy country strategies or priorities under the EU accession process. - R1: Ministério da Educação Nacional, Ensino Superior e Investigação Científica (MENESIC) com competências reforçadas em gestão e administração escolar, regulamentação, certificação, incluindo a melhoria contínua da prática inspetiva

- R2: Inspeção Geral de Educação (IGE) com competências reforçadas e capacidade de replicação ao nível da supervisão administrativa e pedagógica

- R3: IGE e estruturas de gestão locais com competências e ferramentas reforçadas para promover a participação da comunidade na gestão educativa

Para tal, o projeto visa contribuir para o reforço dos modelos e protocolos da inspeção; reforçar as competências dos quadros do MENESIC em gestão e administração escolar, com recurso a procedimentos e instrumentos harmonizados; melhorar as condições infraestruturais e em termos de equipamentos da IG; criar ou reabilitar e atualizar um site do MENESIC para compilar e divulgar informação e documentos oficiais; desenvolver a certificação e especialização da prática inspetiva e promover a progressiva autonomia da IGE na replicação de conhecimentos e competências, com a criação de uma bolsa de inspetores formadores; apoiar a prática inspetiva nas escolas através da formação contínua de inspetores; promover a elaboração de planos de intervenção para as Escolas, incluindo Projetos Educativos, e reforçar as competências dos elencos diretivos para a capacitação e promoção da participação das comunidades escolares na gestão e administração escolar e promover a sensibilização do público em geral para a gestão educativa e temas transversais.

Este trabalho será realizado em permanente articulação com os dirigentes e técnicos do MENESIC, em particular, da IGE, promovendo a construção de uma visão conjunta dos objetivos a atingir e da lógica de intervenção, apostando em modelos formação em cascata, devidamente acompanhados e enquadrados juridicamente, promovendo a continuidade e sustentabilidade do trabalho futuro.

A ação abrangerá todo o território nacional, designadamente as 11 regiões educativas do país, cobrindo 46 setores.

The Overall Objective (Impact) of this Action is to promote public finance transparency and accountability in Guinea-Bissau.

Indeed, the Action focuses on encouraging strategic administrative reforms to consolidate the foundations of sound public financial management by strengthening budgetary discipline, ensuring efficient allocation of financial resources in line with policy priorities, and improving effective and efficient provision of public services. Additionally, the Action seeks to strengthen financial control bodies and procedures, including fostering civil society participation, to reinforce the fight against corruption.

The Specific Objectives (SO)

Based on the general objective of this Action, two specific objectives have been defined, which the project aims to achieve and towards which it is oriented. These are:

SO1. To improve the effectiveness of public financial management systems, procedures, and capacities, with a gender and environmental sensitive perspective (Outcome 1).

SO2. To strengthen the framework and conditions for participation, transparency, and oversight in financial governance and the fight against corruption (Outcome 2).


·    Within the framework of the SO1, the expected outputs contributing are:

1.1    Enhanced capacity of public finance stakeholders in gender and environment responsive budget and strategic planning

1.2    Expenditure programming and budgeting systems and processes are strengthened while taking into gender and environment perspectives

1.3    Systems and processes for expenditure execution, procurement and internal control are enhanced.

·      Within the framework of the SO2, the expected outputs contributing are:

2.1    Public and equal access to information on public finances is promoted.

2.2    Enhanced capacity of the Parliament, the Court of Auditors and civil society for oversight of public finance management.

2.3    Improved mechanisms for fighting against corruption.

title.narrative: Promoção das Cadeias de Valor da Agricultura e da Pesca na Guiné-Bissau

description.narrative:
O objetivo geral:

O objetivo geral desta iniciativa é contribuir para o crescimento económico sustentável e a criação de empregos dignos nos espaços verdes e azuis, através do desenvolvimento inclusivo e sustentável de cadeias de valor com elevado potencial nos setores da agricultura e da pesca.


Os objetivos específicos :

OS1. «Melhorar o ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento de cadeias de valor alimentares sustentáveis, inclusivas e resilientes»

R1.1 Reforçar as capacidades do governo e das principais partes interessadas para elaborar e implementar políticas, leis e estratégias relacionadas com o ambiente empresarial e a qualidade e segurança alimentar, propícias ao desenvolvimento sustentável das cadeias de valor selecionadas;

R1.2. Reforçar o acesso ao financiamento inclusivo para micro, pequenas e médias empresas (MPME).


OS2. «Melhorar a eficácia, a resiliência climática, a inclusão e a sustentabilidade de certas cadeias de valor da agricultura e da pesca, nomeadamente a castanha de caju, o arroz, uma seleção de frutas e plantas tropicais e a pesca».

R2.1. Reforçar as capacidades dos intervenientes nas cadeias de valor para o seu desenvolvimento e uma gestão sustentáveis, eficazes, inclusivos e adaptados ao clima;

R2.2. Melhorar as infraestruturas e instalações ao longo das cadeias de valor selecionadas para aumentar as capacidades de produção, transformação, armazenamento e distribuição, com desenvolvimento do valor acrescentado.


OS3. «Melhorar a competitividade dos empresários em determinadas cadeias de valor da agricultura e da pesca».

R3.1 Melhorar a capacidade das incubadoras de empresas para promover e reforçar o empreendedorismo nas cadeias de valor selecionadas;

R3.2 Melhorar o acesso a oportunidades comerciais, parcerias e redes entre as partes interessadas das cadeias de valor selecionadas.
